items.source: A ClassVisitor that generates a corresponding ClassFile structure, as defined in the Java Virtual Machine Specification (JVMS).
items.translation: 一个生成与 Java 虚拟机规范（JVMS）中定义的 ClassFile 结构相对应的 ClassVisitor。

items.source: Makes the given visitor visit the JVMS ClassFile structure passed to the constructor of this ClassReader.
items.translation: 使给定的访问者访问传递给此 ClassReader 构造函数的 JVMS ClassFile 结构。

items.source: Constructs a new ClassVisitor.
items.translation: 构造一个新的ClassVisitor。

items.source: The class visitor to which this visitor must delegate method calls.
items.translation: 必须委托方法调用的类访问者。
